title: Bi-Weekly Mortgage Trick Saves $27k and 4 Years
hook_text: PAY HALF AS OFTEN, END 4 YEARS EARLIER

beats.say: A $300,000 mortgage at 7% for 30 years costs $400,000 in interest.
beats.visual: extreme close of a mortgage statement on wet asphalt, rain droplets catching sodium streetlight

beats.say: You pay $2,000 a month. Same money, but split into $1,000 every two weeks.
beats.visual: silhouette of a hand placing two paychecks on a table, low angle under a single hanging bulb

beats.say: Most think it’s the same as paying monthly. It’s not.
beats.visual: empty highway at night, headlights streaking past a road sign half-blurred

beats.say: 52 weeks a year means 26 bi-weekly payments. That’s 13 full payments, not 12.
beats.visual: calendar pages flipping under cold fluorescent light, extreme close on the 13th month

beats.say: That extra $2,000 a year cuts 4 years off the loan. Total interest? $373,000.
beats.visual: high angle of a calculator showing numbers, shadow cutting across a tower edge

beats.say: You save $27,000 and own the house 4 years sooner.
beats.visual: silhouette of a house key against a foggy skyline at blue hour

beats.say: Same annual budget. Just a calendar tweak.
beats.visual: extreme wide of a ridge line, tiny human holding a checkbook

beats.say: Why don’t banks offer this? It hurts their profits.
beats.visual: glass bank door from a low angle, rain-slick street reflecting its shine

beats.say: You make 13 payments a year. They want 12.
beats.visual: open water, distant city lights blurred, a single paycheck floating on the surface

beats.say: Set it up once. The math does the rest.
beats.visual: hands placing a payment stub into an envelope, extreme close on the sealing flap

beats.say: 4 years of your life. $27,000 in your pocket. Same annual cost.
beats.visual: empty chair on a tower edge, wind blowing a mortgage statement into the void

caption:
Pay half as often, end 4 years earlier. Same annual budget, $27k saved.
#StoreMoreWealth #BiWeeklyPayments #MortgageHack #QuietMoney #DebtFree
description: Splitting your monthly mortgage payment into bi-weekly halves cuts 4 years off a 30-year loan and saves tens of thousands in interest. Same annual budget, just a calendar tweak.
first_comment: Would you try this if your lender made it easy?

facts.claim: A $300,000 mortgage at 7% for 30 years costs $400,000 in interest.
facts.basis: Standard amortization calculation at 7% APR for 30 years.

facts.claim: Bi-weekly payments (26/year) on the same mortgage save ~4 years and ~$27,000 in interest.
facts.basis: Amortization schedule comparison: 30-year monthly vs bi-weekly on $300,000 at 7%.

facts.claim: Bi-weekly payments create 13 full monthly payments per year, not 12.
facts.basis: 52 weeks / 2 = 26 payments; 26 bi-weekly payments = 13 full monthly equivalents.

loop_map.stakes: A $300,000 mortgage at 7% for 30 years costs $400,000 in interest.
loop_map.big_question: How can you cut 4 years off a 30-year loan without paying extra?
loop_map.assume: Bi-weekly payments are the same as monthly payments.
loop_map.reveal: Bi-weekly payments create 13 full monthly payments per year, saving $27,000 and 4 years.
